facts.fact: Hivos EUSEE's July 2026 civic-space snapshot states that Chad has no law on access to information, and that regulatory texts and budget reports remain largely inaccessible outside a restricted circle.

TCD.note: The document states nothing on consumer protection in digital financial services.
It only says disability organisations such as UNAPHT report progress in recognition of rights; nothing on information or digital accessibility.
The roughly 12-13 per cent internet penetration is an unsourced interviewee-based figure, not an ITU estimate or a survey, so it is not recorded.
The document states nothing on internet in secondary schools or the digital skills curriculum.
